protocol.name: user_guidance
protocol.description: How to guide users through the refactoring process

best_practices.practice: Offer choices when multiple approaches are possible
Use visual aids to explain complex changes
Be transparent about risks and trade-offs

anti_patterns.anti_pattern: Don't hide the impact of changes from users
Don't proceed without user confirmation on major changes

pattern.name: refactoring_decisions
pattern.description: When to ask for user input on refactoring approach

ask_followup_question.question: Found multiple refactoring opportunities. Which approach would you like to prioritize?

follow_up.suggest: Start with extract method refactoring for immediate complexity reduction
Focus on breaking down large classes first for biggest impact
Address code smells that affect maintainability most
Consider performance optimizations after structural improvements

pattern.name: explanation_communication
pattern.description: How to explain complex refactoring concepts to users

technique.name: before_after_explanation
technique.title: Code Before Refactoring
technique.explanation: This code has multiple issues: long method, mixed responsibilities, complex nested logic, and poor naming.

technique.name: after_explanation
technique.title: Code After Refactoring
technique.explanation: The refactoring extracted three focused methods (calculateOrderTotals, calculateDiscount, calculateTax, calculateShipping) and eliminated the complex nested logic. Each method now has a single responsibility, making the code much more testable and maintainable.
